verdict: UNSETTLED for [N1]. The one test internal to the paper implies ROUNDING; the 4 informative leaderboard cells split 3 ROUNDING / 1 TRUNCATION, and that source is a moving target two years newer than the paper, so a single disagreeing cell is as likely to be a different run as a different convention. ⛔ No convention may be assumed.
consequence: SPEC AMENDMENT A1: the verdict reports BOTH readings of the measured value at the table's printed precision — round-half-up and truncate — and a cell counts as REPRODUCED only if BOTH read the published digits. One-sided agreement is reported as REPRODUCED_UNDER_<convention> with the other reading printed beside it, never as a bare REPRODUCED, and never chosen for being the flattering one.
